result.reason: The file satisfies all three test conventions. Subject framing: the top-level describe names the module ('tasting-menu'), nested describes are all 'when' clauses, and each it reads as a sentence with describe. One assertion per block: every it contains exactly one expect, and compound shapes are asserted once via toEqual/toMatchObject. Functionality over implementation: tests exercise only the exported buildMenu public API, use the honest in-memory createMemoryStore with no spies or mocks, and build fresh state in beforeEach so suites don't depend on each other.
